summary: Whole-branch Codex autoreview (gpt-5.6-sol, high) across the PREFLIGHT-1 branch. Part A (facade grantability) and Part C (declare-at-creation guidance, compiled-prompt test) came back correct (0.94/0.97). Part B (creation notification) surfaced real issues over two rounds, all fixed: stale-setup-state on the async notify (now revalidates the freshly-loaded job), a removed-arg test, a passive-event loss when the port is absent (now falls back to recordJobSetupRequired), a Control-route port bound to the process-global repo (now bound to the injected repository), and a wrong-app attribution on one creation path (now uses the canonical session.appId). No accepted actionable findings remain.

non_blocking_findings.summary: check-then-mark setup-notification dedup is not an atomic claim; a job run within the sub-second window after creation could duplicate the card. Deferred as D-0053; documented in code.

residual_risks: Atomic notify-claim hardening deferred (D-0053); near-unreachable for normal future-scheduled jobs.
recommendation: Land; D-0053 tracked with a revisit trigger.
